newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 opens at a record after BoE remarks.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 opens at a record after BoE remarks.

text.p: Leading UK blue chips crept further into record territory on Monday, lifted by bullish comments from the Bank of England and another solid performance on Wall Street on Friday, dealers said.
At 0841 GMT, the benchmark FTSE 100 was 7.0 points to 4,427.3.points.
Gilts also advanced after Bank of England Eddie George said he believes the government can reach the 2.5 percent inflation target this year.
